description: This Java abstract class 'KeysToMultiValues' manages a multimap of key-value pairs with various methods for adding, removing, and retrieving entries, supporting different input types and configurations. It is part of the 'org.mockserver.model' package and appears to be a core component for handling key-value collections within the MockServer project.

classes.name: KeysToMultiValues
classes.description: An abstract class that manages a multimap of key-value pairs with flexible entry management, supporting different input types and key matching styles.

methods.name: withEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple entries to the multimap from a map or list of entries.

methods.name: withEntry
methods.description: Adds a single entry to the multimap, either from an object or key-value pair.

methods.name: replaceEntry
methods.description: Replaces an existing entry with a new one.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all entries as a list of KeyToMultiValue objects.

methods.name: containsEntry
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists by key or key-value pair.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the multimap is empty.
